RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

That number expresses uncertainty, not a statistically grounded estimate; these facts cannot establish whether sex influenced the decision.

An all-male panel is worth noting as a process concern, but is not itself evidence of discrimination. Your longer experience warrants asking how candidates were assessed, although client relationships, management ability and business development may legitimately outweigh years of service.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting and feedback against them. You can neutrally ask how the panel ensured a fair, unbiased assessment. Neither the announcement nor two weeks’ silence establishes discrimination.

If you suspect unlawful treatment, seek local employment or equality advice promptly: complaint deadlines vary and may run while you await a response.
